Verify Now Blog > Holiday Schedule of Mid-Autumn Festival & National Day 2026 Holiday Schedule of Mid-Autumn Festival & National Day 2026 by: Mila Sep 18,2026 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News Dear PCBWayers: Thank you for your continued support and trust in us throughout the year. To celebrate Mid-Autumn Festival & National Day 2026, the PCBWay factory will be on holiday during this period. Orders can still be placed during the holiday and will be processed in order after production resumes. Please plan your orders according to the holiday schedule below. Mid-Autumn Festival factory schedule: 1.Standard PCB: Sep 25th 2.Stencil: Sep. 26th~ 27th. 3.Advanced PCB: Sep. 25th~ 27th. 4.PCB Assembly: Sep. 25th. 5.CNC | 3D Printing: Sep. 25th~ 26th. 6.PCB Design: Sep. 25th~ 27th. National Day factory schedule: 1.Standard PCB: Oct.1st~ 4th. 2.Stencil: Oct.1st~ 2nd. 3.Advanced PCB: Oct.1st~ 5th. 4.PCB Assembly: Oct.1st~ 3rd. 5.CNC | 3D Printing: Oct.1st~ 5th. 6.PCB Design: Oct.1st~ 5th. Mid-Autumn Festival Logistics schedule: DHL: Sep. 25th and 27th. FedEx: Sep. 25th and 27th. Global Standard Shipping, Global Direct Shipping, Global Economy Shipping: Sep. 25th and 27th. EMS, China Post, E-packet,PostNL International Mail: Sep. 25th ~ 27th. National Day Logistics schedule: DHL: Oct. 1st~4th. FedEx: Oct. 1st~5th. Global Standard Shipping, Global Direct Shipping, Global Economy Shipping: Oct.1st~2nd and Oct.4th. EMS, China Post, E-packet,PostNL International Mail: Oct. 1st~5th.
